text:
Erin: Quick proposal — tighten the postmortem follow-ups. Goals: faster closure, clear owners, detect recurring patterns earlier, and formalize a weekly closure pulse. TL;DR: 72h owner assignment, 14d remediation window, weekly pulse, and weekly IC rotation.

Ben: +1, we keep leaking items into a long tail. 14d feels aggressive for infra fixes though.

Aisha: Can we split by severity? Sev1/2 = 14d, Sev3 = 30d? Also need verification steps, not just code changes.

Carla: Agree on verification. Also propose an explicit verification owner separate from implementer. Helps avoid 'dev moved on' cases.

Erin: Good call. Updated proposal:
- 72h: owner assigned (named person)
- 14d: remediation due for Sev1/2; 30d for Sev3
- Verification owner + sign-off step within 3d after remediation
- Weekly closure pulse (15 min) to triage overdue items
- Incident Commander rotation to be weekly; ICs auto-scheduled from oncall calendar

Mateo: How do we track the weekly pulse? Jira filter + Slack summary?

Erin: Suggestion: automated summary from ops-bot to #eng-oncall every Monday 09:00 with items overdue, owners, and recurrence flags. Manual review during the 15-min pulse.

ops-bot: I can post a digest. Draft summary format attached.

Ben: Draft timeline template (use in postmortem and Jira description):
```
Action: short description
Owner: full name + team
Severity: Sev1/2/3
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Verifier: full name
Verification: steps taken / links to runbooks / test results
Recurrence flag: yes/no + previous incidents list
Notes: short
```

Aisha: +1 to recurrence flag. We should automatically tag any action that references a prior incident page. ops-bot can add the tag if it finds a link.

Carla: On the IC rotation — prefer 7-day slots so folks can overlap with oncall. But we need a lightweight handoff checklist for ICs.

Erin: Proposed IC handoff checklist snippet:
```
- Current open incident(s) + status
- Pending remediations and owners
- High-risk services to watch
- Escalation contacts (oncall leads)
- Next scheduled closure pulse meeting time
```

Mateo: Nice. Also propose an 'ownership SLA shadow' — if owner doesn't update status inside 48h, assigned backup gets pinged and PM is copied. Reduces stalls.

Erin: I like that. Let's make the backup assignment mandatory on owner assignment (owner selects backup). ops-bot will escalate after 48h with a gentle reminder and then escalate to PM after 72h.

Ben: Workload concern: for small teams this might be overhead. Can we set a threshold where minor action items under 2h work are auto-verified by owner and closed in 7d?

Aisha: That seems reasonable. Add a "small-change" tag that short-circuits the flow: owner marks small-change, provides 1-2 verification steps, auto-close in 7d unless flagged. ops-bot will surface them in pulse but deprioritize.

Carla: Operational questions: who owns the weekly pulse facilitation? Rotating between SRE, Eng-Infra, and Product-Ops. 3-week cycle so no one team is overloaded.

Erin: Ok — rotation for pulse facilitators: SRE -> Eng-Infra -> Product-Ops. Facilitator responsibilities: run the 15-min meeting, triage backlog, confirm any escalations.

Mateo: If everyone is good, I'll prototype the handoff checklist + a sample Jira template this week and ping ops-bot to draft the Monday digest.

Ben: :thumbsup: Please add a short retro after 2 months to see friction.

Erin: Agreed. Add a 60-day retro item to the plan. I'll create the parent ticket and assign action owners for this rollout.

ops-bot: Created draft digest job (private). Will need a reviewer.

Aisha: I can review the digest logic.

Carla: I'll review the Jira templates and verification checklist.

Erin: Great. Action items from thread:
- Mateo: prototype handoff checklist + Jira template (due: 7 days)
- ops-bot: draft Monday digest job and auto-tag logic (in progress)
- Aisha: review digest logic (due: 3 days)
- Carla: review templates and verification criteria (due: 3 days)
- Erin: create rollout parent ticket and schedule 60-day retro (due: 2 days)

Erin: Thanks everyone — we'll run this as a 2-sprint pilot and adjust. :rocket:
